guidance.explanation: E-commerce entities must display customer-care and grievance-officer contact information and maintain a grievance mechanism. Marketplace seller details can help identify whom to contact.
For a proved defective-goods complaint, the Act provides possible remedies including replacement or return of the price. A refund is not an automatic or guaranteed outcome.

The e-commerce rules restrict refusal to take back goods or refund a paid price in specified situations, including defective goods or goods not matching what was advertised or agreed. This is not a universal change-of-mind refund right.
